items.title: Hero word on a hard cut
items.description: One word or number fills half to nearly all of the frame width (`frameWidth` up to 0.95) on a hard cut, the ground swapping on the same frame; an optional caption joins beside it. Optional scale keyframes (shrink on a beat, settle, re-grow), a drift carried across the cut and a true sub-frame blur shutter (`scaleKeys`, `driftFrom`, `blurWindows`; off by default, all on in `heroWordShrinkPreset`); `entry: "arc"` rises in on a baseline whose bend eases to straight in 9 frames (`heroWordArcPreset`). No flash, ring or glow: size and the cut are the event. For the stat, the turn or the drop.

items.title: Word per pulse
items.description: A word per beat, each on a hard cut and its own ground (black, paper, signal red), alternating big and small, the awaited word landing last in the accent; optional acceleration makes the last repeats rush. Takes beat frames from audio:map or a BPM. For openers and drops.

items.title: Sentence build with inline chips
items.description: A sentence builds word by word on a light ground, icon or logo chips (code, film, music, terminal, cube, play, render and more) popping in as words and marked numbers in the accent. By default (`layout: "flow"`) it re-centres as each word opens its space and leaves through blur; `layout: "fixed"` lays the block out first, switches each word on whole, rises in (`riseFrom`), creeps (`creep`) and leaves upward on an ease-in (`exit: "rise"`); `sentenceBuildFixedPreset` sets all of it. `tint` brings each word on in a run of colours that settles to its ink (`sentenceBuildTintPreset`, `sentenceBuildCoolingPreset`), `cornerDots` frames the line with four dots that spread after each word, and the fixed layout's `fadeFrames` fades word groups in place under a slow `push` (`sentenceBuildFadeGroupsPreset`). For a hook or claim that names who or what it serves.

cashfree 2.4 s: an object inline as a word

items.title: Front-loaded number race
items.description: A figure races from one value to another, most of the way in the first few frames, then creeps and stops dead, an arc of ticks lighting with it on a pale ground. `curve` picks the roll-up (front-loaded, power3.out, power1.out or a linear running count) in whole units every frame, `locale` and `digits: "proportional"` set the figure as the reference does, and `container: "pill"` grows a pill from a dot that counts to the target (`numberRaceBadgePreset`). For the money or count a claim is about; the stop is the beat.

items.title: Lower third: name and role

items.title: Caret-tracking typewriter
items.description: A line types at hero scale with a block or bar caret, about 1.2 frames a character, and the frame follows the caret: once the line reaches `anchor` each key pushes it left, so the start of the sentence runs off the left edge and the eye never travels. The newest word is tinted for a few frames; the caret blinks on a 19-frame cycle only when idle; optionally the line deletes backwards by word (or by character, `backspaceUnit: "char"`, `caretTrackCharBackspacePreset`) and a correction types or scrambles in; `chips` ride the caret and park in the line (`caretTrackChipPreset`). `retypeLine` deletes a whole typed line and types a second in its place: hold after the last key, backspace by word or character, select-all or cut, empty frames, its own retype unit and pace (`caretTrackRetypeWordPreset`, `caretTrackRetypeCharPreset`); `caret: "none"` hides the caret. For a query, a prompt or a claim the film then corrects.

abdulah t01 0.13-4.33 s (30 fps, on twos): no caret, typed about 2 frames a character in bursts, held 16 frames, last word greyed one step, deleted backwards in 5 word chunks every 2 frames (7 words in 10 frames, about 0.7 a frame), first word slid right and hard-swapped on F130; caretTrackRetypeWordPreset

items.description: A word or short line splits open: the gap opens accelerating (about 0.08 of the width in 5 frames), an element grows from a dot or rises tilted from below and settles into the gap in about 5 frames, then the halves frame it (`mode: "part"`) or scale up and are thrown off both edges (`"fling"`, `wordSplitInsertFlingPreset`). For an opener or a tagline that should land as one shape before it is read.

items.title: Print type
items.description: A word printed onto a paper ground in one of four print gestures: `scan` builds it upward behind a thin coloured line on twos with colour misregistration; `stamp` slams it from twice its size and faint to solid in 4 frames, multiplied into the paper, the frame jolting on contact (`printTypeStampPreset`); `scrap` sets each glyph on its own torn scrap with its own face, colour and tilt, 2-3 frames apart (`printTypeScrapPreset`); `ink` holds it faint, then full in one frame under a 12-frame whole-frame flicker (`printTypeInkPreset`). For a period, paper or zine look where type is made, not set.

paper-style 33.83-33.97 s: a stamp from big and faint to small and solid in 4 frames (power2.in, inferred), multiplied on the paper, the frame shifting about 4 frames after contact
paper-style 2.03-2.63 s: each letter on its own scrap with its own face and colour, landing with slight rotation 2-3 frames apart
paper-style 55.93-56.33 s: a title at about 15% contrast snaps to black in one frame under a 12-frame whole-frame flicker

items.title: Marquee rows
items.description: Full-width rows of a repeated phrase with chips between the repeats (or rows of icon tiles), each row offset, all on one track that enters moving and brakes to a near hold (expo.out, about 25 frames) or slides at a constant speed; repeats alternate with a secondary ink, and `focalScale`/`focalBlur` scale and blur each item by its distance from frame centre (`marqueeRowsFocalPreset`, `marqueeRowsLensPreset`). The rows bleed off both edges by design. For a promise said many times at once, a list of supported things, or words passing a lens.

items.title: Glyph becomes a shape
items.description: A small word holds 5 frames, its letters scatter (4) and fade (3), and one kept letter's box is handed to a stroke that stands alone and lengthens (6), then turns about 35 degrees and extends to about half the frame height on a decelerating ease (6), ready for a match cut onto the shape it now is; `seamFrame` places the cut cue. For a word that names a line, a stroke, a cut or a direction and should become it.

items.title: Film finish
items.description: Wrap a whole film once: by default only a fine frame-seeded grain (0.04), near-invisible, that keeps flat grounds from banding. Vignette, colour fringes, bloom, light leak and drift are opt-in and stock-looking: no reference uses them. Keep Audio and video outside it when aberration is on. `preset` names a finished look: "clean" (grain 0.02, vignette 0.08), "filmic" (grain 0.05, vignette 0.18, slow drift, faint bloom) or "tactile" (grain 0.07, paper texture, vignette 0.12); explicit props override it.
items.usage: import { FilmFinish } from "src/motion/library/finish/FilmFinish"; wrap the whole scene: <FilmFinish>{scene}</FilmFinish>. Defaults are grain 0.04 and nothing else; raise vignette, aberration or bloom only with a reason in the brief. For a whole look pass `preset="clean" | "filmic" | "tactile"` (src/motion/library/finish/presets.ts; explicit props win). Keep <Audio>/<Video> outside.
inspiredBy: whaleyxbt/claude-motion: grain primitives (idea only)

items.title: Anamorphic flare pulse
items.description: An anamorphic lens flare that flashes on beat frames: hot core, long horizontal streak, ghosts across the axis. `angle` tips the streak (a diagonal lens streak), `thickness` blooms it and `intensity` keyframes drive it per frame instead of beats, so it can recede with a subject (`lensStreakPreset(at)`: full on arrival, half 6 frames later, expo.out). Banned by the craft rules unless the brand already uses flares (gaming, sci-fi, music); never as decoration.
items.usage: import { FlarePulse, lensStreakPreset } from "src/motion/library/finish/FlarePulse"; <FlarePulse x={0.5} y={0.45} colour={token} {...lensStreakPreset(arrival)} /> over the receding subject, or hits={[...]} for beat flashes.

items.sparing: Anamorphic flares are stock After Effects decoration and no reference uses one. Justified only when the brand world already has flares (gaming, sci-fi, music video); then on hero beats only, never as idle glow.

items.title: Motion blur
items.description: Directional smear for fast moves, peak held to the craft rules (10 px text, 18 px full frame) and only along the move. 'velocity' mode is one cheap pass; 'shutter' mode is true sub-frame blur from @remotion/motion-blur. Pass the shot's flat ground as `ground` (or `opaque` when the children paint one): shutter samples are then averaged exactly, so an opaque ground keeps its colour on blurred frames.

items.title: Texture overlay
items.description: A material over the whole frame, drawn procedurally per frame with no image files: paper fibre and tooth, an offset halftone dot screen with uneven ink, or CRT scan lines with a slow rolling band. Use it when the film is about print, paper, collage or a screen, at low opacity; FilmFinish's tactile preset adds the paper one.
items.usage: import { TextureOverlay } from "src/motion/library/finish/TextureOverlay"; put <TextureOverlay kind="halftone" opacity={0.22} /> above the scene, or <FilmFinish texture="paper" textureOpacity={0.4}> / preset="tactile". Paper stays still (cadence 0); cadence 2 boils it on film time.

items.title: Grade-step flash on a held plate
items.description: A held plate leaves through whole-frame grade steps of one to three frames each (by default monochrome 3, negative 2, a two-token duotone with an RGB fringe 2, then the cut) and the next plate enters on one negative frame; steps can also be polarity, halftone, a ground blink (flat ground, the subject in light dots), a white bleach decaying over the step, a sine wave displacement in bands, the subject darkened on black, a supplied subject matte tinted (an x-ray: `src` artwork, or `matteSrc` the plate subject's alpha cut-out masking the plate into a tinted negative; make it free and local with `pnpm matte`), or any ground and ink colour with or without the plate (a content-free flash, an inverted title); presets PAPER_BLEACH_ENTER, ABDULAH_WAVE_EXIT, GOJIBERRY_DARK_EXIT, gojiberryXrayExit(src), gojiberryXrayFromCutout(matteSrc) and NOWAK_STROBE_ENTER replay the references' frames. A plate can arrive in seeded horizontal slices jumping sideways that resolve in about 10 frames, its first frame polarity-flipped (`chaos` 1 re-rolls the bands each step, the jumpier look, which then needs a FLASH_RISK check). The cut as an event without a wipe. Default timing stays within three flashes a second (WCAG 2.3.1); keep one such event per second.
items.usage: import { GradeStepFlash, GradeLayer } from "src/motion/library/effects/GradeStepFlash"; <GradeStepFlash exitAt={cut}>{plateA}</GradeStepFlash>, then in <Sequence from={cut}> <GradeStepFlash enterAt={0}>{plateB}</GradeStepFlash>; slice={{ at: 0, frames: 11, bands: 9, offset: 0.2, flipFrames: 1, hold: 2, chaos: 0, seed }} for a sliced entrance. Steps: { grade: mono|negative|polarity|duotone|halftone|ground|bleach|wave|darken|matte|colour, frames, fringe, ground?, ink?, content?, src?, matteSrc? } (colour: ground and ink, content false for a flat flash; matte: src of a white-on-black subject picture, or matteSrc of the plate subject's alpha cut-out at the plate's size); presets in flash-plan.ts. A slice renders the plate once per band: keep sound outside.

items.description: Text behind the subject: a big fitted title rises into the picture's depth, passing behind a person or product while the plate's subject stays in front, cut out by its matte frame by frame (a still or a clip; the subject layer is the same plate masked, so nothing seams). items.title: Audio-reactive pulse (curves demo)
